text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Facing Mr. C.B. again after having lost 
previously, Eishin Flash cannot hide her 
anxiety.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, her Trainer explained that the 
very experience of setback was her 
greatest weapon. Believing those words, 
she stepped forward to challenge the race—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Though she couldn't claim victory, she 
earned Mr. C.B.'s acknowledgment with her 
run, proving beyond doubt that she had 
grown.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Everything was the result of sticking 
strictly to her schedule. Eishin Flash 
resolved to compete as she is now, turning 
over a new leaf as she set her sights on 
the Osaka Hai.
